description: This file defines a sealed class 'InProcessTestSiloSpecificOptions' that encapsulates configuration overrides for individual silos in an Orleans testing environment. It includes properties for silo port, gateway port, and silo name, as well as a static factory method to create instances with specific port allocations based on test cluster configurations.

classes.name: InProcessTestSiloSpecificOptions
classes.description: Configuration override class for individual test silos, providing port settings and silo naming.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate 'InProcessTestSiloSpecificOptions' with predetermined port values based on cluster configuration and whether new ports should be assigned.
